facts.fact: Fraternité reports 445,695 parcels registered in the national cadastre on the ANDF-run e-Foncier Bénin platform, covering 24 arrondissements in 12 communes, with Cotonou fully covered and CEC issuance effective in all 12 communes.

Fraternité reports the PPMEC project (July 2023 to June 2026) is preparing nationwide scale-up of the cadastre, with Parakou and Porto-Novo coverage being finalised and extension under way in further localities.
